mapper.select: SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.status_code AS status_code, asm.name AS assignment_status_name, asm.description AS assignment_status_description, ka.mid_self_score, ka.end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score, ka.end_gm_score, ka.evidences::text AS evidences, ki.target_description, ki.weight, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, kc.name AS category_name, sc_type.name AS kpi_type_name, u.id AS user_id, u.full_name AS user_full_name, u.username AS user_username, r.code AS rank_code, ud.supervisor_id AS assignee_supervisor_id, sup.full_name AS assignee_supervisor_full_name, d.id AS section_id, d.name AS section_name, d.manager_id AS section_manager_id, mgr.full_name AS section_manager_full_name, ( SELECT r2.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r2 ON r2.id = ur.role_id AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r2.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r2.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_code, ( SELECT r2.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r2 ON r2.id = ur.role_id AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r2.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r2.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_name FROM kpi_assignments ka INNER JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes sc_type ON sc_type.code = km.type_code AND sc_type.category = 'KPI_TYPE' LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes asm ON asm.code = ka.status_code AND asm.category = 'ASM_STATUS' INNER JOIN users u ON ka.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ranks r ON jt.rank_id = r.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE INNER JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users mgr ON mgr.id = d.manager_id AND mgr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users sup ON sup.id = ud.supervisor_id AND sup.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.status_code IN (501, 502, 503, 601, 602, 603) ORDER BY d.name, u.full_name, kc.name, km.code
